authors.name: Dr. Aranya Sharma
authors.bio: Dr. Aranya Sharma is a renowned academic and philosopher who has dedicated over 30 years to researching ancient Indian literature. Her works are praised for their scholarly depth and accessibility.

authors.name: Vikram Sethi
authors.bio: Vikram Sethi is a polyglot and master translator known for bringing the nuances of Sanskrit poetry into modern languages without losing their original soul.

authors.name: Meera Iyer
authors.bio: Meera Iyer writes contemporary fiction and poetry that explores themes of identity, culture, and transformation in modern India.

authors.name: Deep Patel
authors.bio: Rooted in values and inspired by life itself, Deep Patel is a writer and publisher at Deepam Kesari Publishing House. He writes with the intention of preserving culture, expressing genuine human emotions, and encouraging positive change through meaningful literature.
authors.academicPedigree: Master's degree in Science (M.Sc.) with specialization in Organic Chemistry
authors.literaryVision: Writing is not merely a profession but a responsibility—to reflect truth, inspire courage, and create stories that leave a thoughtful and lasting impact on readers across generations.

events.title: Book Launch & Reading Circle
events.description: An evening of author reflections, live readings, and intimate conversation with readers.
events.details: The event featured a live reading from the latest release, a panel discussion, and a Q&A session with the author and the audience.

events.title: Literary Festival Showcase
events.description: A vibrant celebration of storytelling, poetry, and emerging voices from across India.
events.details: Visitors enjoyed poetry readings, book stalls, interactive workshops, and networking among authors, publishers, and readers.

events.title: Children's Story Session
events.description: Interactive reading sessions designed to inspire young readers and families.
events.details: The session included storytelling, drawing activities, and a fun discussion about imagination and books for children.
